verdict.rationale: mParticle's Warehouse Sync explicitly ingests data from third-party cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, Databricks) via a dedicated API, and docs reference 'build your own custom integrations' and connecting to 'leading marketing, analytics, and data warehousing solutions' — supporting inbound data beyond just instrumented app SDKs. However, most cited integration docs (e.g., mparticle-docs-11, x2) describe outbound activation to partners rather than inbound feeds from arbitrary third-party cloud apps, and there's no independent/hands-on confirmation of pulling data from non-warehouse SaaS feeds. Missing for 10: documented named third-party app/feed inbound connectors (e.g., CRM, ad platforms) beyond warehouses, and independent verification of inbound feed reliability.
